name: aquilair-fde
description: LLM-assisted ontology metadata design: proposal gate, topology + platform yaml delivery, OQ traceability (v0.4.2)
license: Proprietary - Aquilair internal distribution, intranet use only

displayDescription.en: Designs ontology metadata from business documents: intake and filing, scenario charter, DSL drafting, hard lint, CQ verification, topology and change-set diff, engine-bundle export. Drafts only - human review is the sole authority.
displayDescription.zh: 上传业务文档对话式设计本体：设计稿确认、拓扑图与平台导入yaml双交付，异常与待确认问题全程留痕。
